author: ReBorner
quote: GTA 6 was one of the most anticipated games ever, with a huge budget and multiple delays. After all that waiting, it launches with an unbelievable number of bugs. Animations are rough: Jason’s legs slide along the ground, and the animal animations look like they are from 2010. The graphics aren’t impressive, the main characters feel blank and uncharismatic, and performance is poor, with not even a stable 30 FPS. A massive disappointment for the wait.
